description:
Java Developer with AWS experience - EAd or GC or USC 
 Duration: +1 year
 Location: Portland, OR
 Required Skills: 
 
 
 Sales 2.0 SR JAVA AE 
 SR Application Engineer who is passionate about designing and developing world-class web applications for Nike’s Sales Organization. This Senior Application Engineer will work as part of the eCommerce team developing the next generation of sales tools for Nike. 
 
 
 Required Skills: 
 • 4+ years of experience developing Senior-Level Enterprise Java code under Java versions 6 and/or 7. 
 • 3+ years of experience with Spring Core Framework 3.x. This should include at a minimum Spring MVC and Spring Web Services experience. 
 • 3+ years of experience writing REST Web Services. 
 • 3+ years experience with test driven development. 
 • 2+ years experience with agile methodology and lean principles. 
 • Strong leadership identity. 
 • Excellent verbal and written communication. 
 • Great team collaboration skills. 
 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 
 • A track record of solving problems and getting things done in a fast pace, ever evolving environment. 
 
 Not required, but we use these as well: 
 • MongoDB or other NoSql/Document database. 
 • Groovy + Spock for Testing. 
 • Gradle. 
 • Groovy. 
 • AngularJS. 
 • Chef. 
 • Vagrant. 
 • Go 
 
 
 
 Responsibilities include: 
 • Develop world-class technical solutions to address business needs. 
 • Apply best practices and knowledge of JAVA to develop complex web applications. 
 • Design and develop high-performance distributed services. 
 • Research, prototype and verify software solutions that overcome technical boundaries. 
 • Architect the right kinds of flexibility to fuel growth and sustainability 
 • Generalize and simplify technical solutions to solve multiple needs. 
 • Benchmark possible solutions and implement improvements to expand capacity. 
 • Solve complex problems, explaining difficult issues. 
 • Contribute to design of functional specifications. 
 • Work independently with minimal guidance. 
 • Apply SDLC process to all technology solutions.
